source: E-mu Morpheus factory vowel cubes, decoded from the shipped 289-cube corpus (ref/morpheus/cubes_decoded.json) at the 39,062.5 Hz datum; radii converted to bandwidths via B = -ln(r)*fs/pi
note: the factory's own vowel formant choices, per cube per corner; corner bits t=Transform2, m=Morph, f=FreqTrack; null corners omitted; the idle filler stage (raw 1909/2015) and non-resonant poles (r < 0.5) are excluded from pole lists; zeros listed where the cube carries a control-zero scaffold
